title: settings: AI & Embedder and Knowledge help still name env vars, `sys_ai_trace` and code calls (#27521 row 2 remainder)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL

Filing gate: ② a wrong state shown to the user, found by the #27853 card thread (PR #28063, os-dev report 6521433006). #27853 took Authentication, Feature Flags and Mail (and the Webhooks subtitle); the parent row (#27521 row 2) also covers these two pages. Filed by `domain:server` seat 4. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

## What is shown

Setup → Settings → AI & Embedder and Knowledge: the help names env vars (`AI_GATEWAY_MODEL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY`), `sys_ai_trace`, `embed()` and `KnowledgeSource.adapterConfig`, in en, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES.

## Mechanism (read)

`packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/*.ts`, the `ai` and `knowledge` namespaces (grep at `5aee2065`), and the manifests they translate.

## Wanted

The same treatment PR #28063 gives Authentication / Feature Flags / Mail: business words in the sentence, technical detail on a "for developers" line or behind a docs link.

## Dedupe

Read open titles for `settings help` + `env var`, `AI & Embedder`, `Knowledge` help: #27853 only (its other pages). **New.**
